caption: LUM-1305 — pi-rust TUI: the composer's autocomplete dropdown now renders through the shared SelectList row layout (label column + aligned description column) instead of the editor's own `label  description` renderer. Both captures run this one scenario against two binaries built on the same tree: BEFORE = origin/feature/pi.rs (LUM-1274 tip), AFTER = LUM-1305 rebased onto it. Real binary + real PTY + pyte; the `probe` rows are the A/B markers (XFAIL on BEFORE, PASS on AFTER) and the `reject` rows name the layout the fix removed.
notes: Panel 2/3 are the `/` command menu: upstream's SLASH_COMMAND_SELECT_LIST_LAYOUT (12..32) makes the primary column `widest command name + 2`, so the description column **moves with the command list** — 14 with the pre-LUM-1274 list, 17 once `/scoped-models` (13 chars) exists. The robust discriminator is therefore the `reject` row: the old renderer always emitted exactly two blanks (`❯ help  Show this help text`), the shared SelectList layout never does.

Panel 4 is the `@` file menu: non-slash completions use the SelectList default (a fixed 32-column primary column), so the description starts at column 34 — the same offsets the modal `/model` picker uses.
No mocked rendering: the dropdown is painted by App::paint_autocomplete into the ratatui buffer, the PTY stream is parsed by pyte and the frozen grid is what the assertions read.

panels.label: 2. type `/` — the command menu opens; description column = widest command + 2 (slash layout)
3. type `mo` — the menu narrows; the primary column does not move
4. Ctrl+U clears, then `@` — the file menu uses the default 32-column primary column (description at column 34)
